notes.title: update / patch v1.1.4
notes.notes: [p]Hey all, fixed some issues.[/p][p]I didn't manage to reproduce the bug where items can't be picked up. If anyone knows a way to make the bug happen, please let me know so I can hopefully fix it.[/p][p]Also, I'm sorry I didn't update the game earlier. It took way too long, so apologies for that.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][p]- added a "skip tutorial" option in settings, so you won't have to do the tutorial again in new games[/p][p]- reworded the "trickster" achievement so it's more clear you need all spells AND skills/moves[/p][p]- fixed the "wizard" and "cleric" achievements[/p][p]- fixed a bug where a controller/gamepad would control a second character after a player on keyboard left[/p][p]- fixed being able to trade with the secret smith without doing the associated questline first[/p][p]- fixed some audio issues[/p][p]- fixed steam screenshots[/p][p]- fixed savefiles keep existing after winning/losing[/p][p]- fixed the game being softlocked at the win screen[/p]

notes.title: patch v1.1.2
notes.notes:
patch 1.1.2
- bandana sell value is now 2 gold down from 5
- greatly increased the xp you get from quests
- battles don't continue anymore if players are defeated and ally AI are still alive (unless the fight was prompted by an ally)
- fixed a bug where items (and other objects) didnt get removed properly and would still be visible, but not interactable
- decreased wait time after 'air cutter' and 'hurricane cutter'
- greatly increased damage of 'air cutter' and 'hurrican cutter'
- increased xp gained from bones from 50 -> 60
- fixed a bug where you would stay stuck inside a bridge even after reloading the game
- criticals now always deal at least 1 damage even if blocked
- fixed a bug where starting another game after beating the lich will imeediately suck you into the final fight
- fixed a bug where magic exceeded max magic when unequipping gear that gave extra magic
- fixed a visual bug where projectiles wouldnt be cleared when an enemy/player got defeated in battle
- balanced some enemies
